profile.onboarding: A known character speaks the goal aloud and a replay-voice button lets kids hear it again, so nothing depends on reading.
profile.controls: Tap/click or drag along the path; arrow keys on desktop.
profile.core_loop: Guide the character to a friend or item through a short path.
profile.goals_and_rewards: Character celebrates on success; some games award stickers or collectibles.
profile.difficulty_curve: Very gentle, with almost no way to fail outright.
profile.game_feel: Soft, friendly audio/visual feedback on every tap.
profile.art_and_audio: Familiar TV characters, full voice-over, and music throughout.
profile.usability: Built for pre-readers, with idle hints if a child pauses too long.
profile.accessibility: Large touch targets, audio-first instructions, no reading required.
profile.notes: General knowledge only, not played this session; useful mainly as a contrast for how much mazle relies on unvoiced text.
